tex_content.html:
Definition

For a Lie group $G$, write $L_g(h)=gh$. A vector field $X$ on $G$ is left-invariant if it is $L_g$-related to itself for every $g\in G$; equivalently, \[ d(L_g)_{g'}(X_{g'})=X_{gg'} \qquad (g,g'\in G). \tag {8.12} \] Since every $L_g$ is a diffeomorphism, this condition is also $(L_g)_*X=X$. Smooth left-invariant fields form a linear subspace of $\mathfrak {X}(G)$.
